query:
SELECT 
  ae.accountId,
  coa.code,
  coa.name,
  coa.level,
  coa.parentCode,
  coa.isAnalytical,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_lancamentos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ae.entryType = 'C' THEN ae.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_credito,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ae.entryType = 'D' THEN ae.amount ELSE 0 END) as total_debito
FROM accountingEntries ae
INNER JOIN journals j ON ae.journalId = j.id
INNER JOIN chartOfAccounts coa ON ae.accountId = coa.id
WHERE ae.competenceMonth = '2026-01'
  AND j.status = 'POSTED'
  AND coa.code LIKE '4%'
GROUP BY ae.accountId, coa.code, coa.name, coa.level, coa.parentCode, coa.isAnalytical
ORDER BY coa.code;
